label: Autoscout24

discovery.auth: API credentials issued to dealers/DMS partners

reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence high). AutoScout24 Switzerland (SMG) publishes an OpenAPI developer portal for DMS/HCI listing APIs; credentials for dealers and DMS partners.

reason: Upload-only official API (https://developers.autoscout24.ch/): AutoScout24 Switzerland (SMG) publishes an OpenAPI developer portal for DMS/HCI listing APIs; credentials for dealers and DMS partners. It manages the account's own adverts (create/update/delete) and has no public listing search, VIN decode or valuation; the automotive vocabulary is read-only (no write verbs), so it is recorded, not served.
